mapper.select: SELECT si.seq AS seq, CAST(si.seq AS VARCHAR(2)) + '교시(' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), si.starts_at, 108) + ' ~ ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), si.ends_at, 108) + ')' AS label FROM erp_bookstore_slot_instance si WHERE si.service_date = #{date} AND si.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY si.seq ASC

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, cd.codeNm AS gradeName,
COALESCE(TRY_CAST(dia.record_time AS INT), si.seq) AS slotSeq, CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(dia.record_time AS INT), si.seq) AS VARCHAR(2)) + '교시(' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), si.starts_at, 108) + ' ~ ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), si.ends_at, 108) + ')' AS slotLabel,
cs.session_id AS sessionId, dia.diary_key AS diaryKey,
dia.is_send AS isSend, -- 120 = yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss → VARCHAR(16)이면 "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), dia.send_at, 120) AS sendAt,
-- 앱 미가입(토큰 없음/빈 문자열)이면 발송 자체가 불가하다 — 토큰 원본은 내리지 않는다 CAST(CASE WHEN NULLIF(st.app_token, '') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS BIT) AS hasAppToken FROM erp_bookstore_reservation r JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance si ON si.slot_instance_id = r.slot_instance_id JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = r.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code cd ON cd.gubun = 'S' AND cd.code = st.grade_key OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 session_id FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session WHERE student_id = r.student_id AND session_date = si.service_date ORDER BY session_id DESC ) cs LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_diary dia ON dia.session_id = cs.session_id WHERE si.service_date = #{date} AND si.center_code = #{centerCode} AND r.status <> 'CANCELED'
AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(dia.record_time AS INT), si.seq) = #{slotSeq}
AND st.student_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%'
ORDER BY COALESCE(TRY_CAST(dia.record_time AS INT), si.seq) ASC, st.student_name ASC

SELECT dia.diary_key AS diaryKey, dia.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName FROM erp_bookstore_diary dia JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = dia.student_id WHERE st.center_code = #{centerCode} AND dia.is_send = 0 AND dia.diary_key IN #{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE dia SET dia.is_send = 1, dia.send_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) FROM erp_bookstore_diary dia JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = dia.student_id WHERE st.center_code = #{centerCode} AND dia.is_send = 0 AND dia.diary_key IN #{key}
